properties.name: firebase.apps.default.credentials
properties.description: Location of a credentials JSON file, e.g. 'classpath:firebase.json' or 'file:/etc/firebase.json'. Application Default Credentials are used when not set.

properties.name: firebase.apps.default.service-account-id
properties.description: Service account email used to sign custom tokens.

properties.name: firebase.apps.default.database-auth-variable-override
properties.description: Value of the 'auth' variable in Realtime Database security rules.

properties.name: firebase.apps.default.connect-timeout
properties.description: Connect timeout for outgoing HTTP connections. Plain numbers are interpreted as milliseconds.

properties.name: firebase.apps.default.read-timeout
properties.description: Read timeout for outgoing HTTP connections. Plain numbers are interpreted as milliseconds.

properties.name: firebase.apps.default.write-timeout
properties.description: Write timeout for outgoing HTTP connections. Plain numbers are interpreted as milliseconds.

properties.name: firebase.apps.default.auth.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register a FirebaseAuth bean.

properties.name: firebase.apps.default.db.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register a FirebaseDatabase bean. Only takes effect when 'db.url' is set.

properties.name: firebase.apps.default.messaging.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register a FirebaseMessaging bean.

properties.name: firebase.apps.default.storage.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register a StorageClient bean. Only takes effect when 'storage.bucket' is set.

properties.name: firebase.apps.default.storage.bucket
properties.description: The default Cloud Storage bucket name, without the 'gs://' prefix.

properties.name: firebase.apps.default.firestore.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register a Firestore bean.

values.description: The default Firebase app, exposed as the primary FirebaseApp bean.
